The HWPX renewal playbook update succeeded with a perfect reward score, validating the integration of the legacy pytest suite.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.80 with zero errors across all trials. The test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite passed successfully in 0.118 seconds using pytest version 7.4.4. Results were successfully serialized to result.json, confirming the stability of the hermes (kimi-k2.5) agent on the adhoc dataset.
